title: Purifying rotten meat
body:
Do you think that too much carrion is useless, except for feeding the dogs, so this mod brings you a more useful method, you can get purified carrion by burning it in a smoker for 10 seconds, and if you want carrion, this mod purifies carrion into edible carrion

than the effect of rotten flesh change:
Nutritional value:4→6
Satiety:1→0
